"""One finite Git-only publisher for an actually claimed following production run."""
import json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now
run=sys.argv[1];assert re.fullmatch(r'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v[0-9]+',run)
assert int(run.rsplit('-v',1)[1])>=6
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025';state_path=folder/('publisher-'+run+'.json')
assert not state_path.exists(),'A prior publisher for this run requires reconciliation, never restart blindly'
prior=read_json(folder/'publisher-state.json')
assert prior['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline','Prior v5 publisher must finish its exact readback first'
for path in folder.glob('publisher-resume-*.json'):
    assert read_json(path)['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline','Another following publisher requires reconciliation'
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')
assert owner=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
assert production['status']=='running' and production['machine_id']==machine_id()
deadline=datetime.fromisoformat(production['created_at_utc'])+timedelta(seconds=23400)
assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline
lock=folder/'publisher.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
state={'machine_id':machine_id(),'pid':os.getpid(),'run_id':run,'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'production_created_at_utc':production['created_at_utc'],'original_deadline_utc':deadline.isoformat(),'checkpoints':[],'scope':'Finite Git-only successor after the prior publisher actually finished/released its unique lock. No generation, output approval, canonical writes or image request replay. Normal LOW snapshots, fast-forward pushes and exact pinned original-byte verification.'}
def persist(**kw):state.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(state_path,state)
def checked(args,timeout=1800):
    r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
    if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)
    return r.stdout
try:
    last=0;persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_checkpoint_requests=last)
    while datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline:
        owner_path=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json'
        live=owner_path.exists() and read_json(owner_path).get('run_id')==run
        production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
        calls=production['completed_source_requests'];running=live and production['status']=='running'
        if calls-last<16 and running:
            persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_completed_requests=calls,last_checkpoint_requests=last);time.sleep(20);continue
        if last==calls and not running:break
        readback_lock=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock'
        if readback_lock.exists():
            persist(status='waiting_for_existing_original_readback',last_completed_requests=calls);time.sleep(20);continue
        seq=len(state['checkpoints'])+1;batch='resumed-low-'+run.rsplit('-',1)[-1]+'-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        while (ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch).exists():
            seq+=1;batch='resumed-low-'+run.rsplit('-',1)[-1]+'-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        persist(status='snapshotting_LOW_scope',last_completed_requests=calls)
        checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
        receipt=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints/{batch}/receipt.json')
        publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not publication.exists()
        write_json(publication,{**receipt,'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
        state['checkpoints'].append({'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'completed_requests_at_snapshot':calls,'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs']})
        persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_immutable_snapshot')
        checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),receipt['commit'],batch])
        assert read_json(publication)['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
        last=calls;persist(status='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=receipt['commit'])
        if not running:break
    persist(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:
    persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()
